Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Financial Systems organization partners with Stripe’s People organization to build trusted, intuitive products for employees, managers, and People professionals. We aim to make routine interactions simple and self-service while ensuring that work requiring judgment or care reaches the right person with the right context.

Our products connect data, knowledge, workflows, and systems that span the employee experience. We are building toward a future in which employees and managers can get accurate answers and complete common tasks without navigating fragmented tools, while People teams can spend more time on the work that benefits most from

What you’ll do

You will own products that make it easier for employees to get accurate guidance and complete common People-related tasks, while helping People team focus their expertise on work that requires judgment and care. You will identify the highest-impact user problems, define the product strategy and roadmap, and lead products from discovery through delivery, adoption, and iteration.

This is an opportunity to shape a growing product area at the intersection of employee experience, enterprise systems, data, and applied AI. You will help develop agentic products that connect people to accurate guidance, automate appropriate actions, and help People practitioners focus their expertise where it matters most. Success requires understanding the capabilities and limitations of AI and machine learning when applied to business-critical, regulated, and strictly governed problems. You will also use AI-enabled tools throughout the product development lifecycle to accelerate discovery, prototyping, requirements development, evaluation, and iteration while protecting employee trust.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of employees, managers, and People practitioners, then translate their most important needs into a focused product roadmap
  • Own products end to end, from problem discovery and strategy through delivery, adoption, measurement, and iteration
  • Design coherent experiences that connect fragmented data, knowledge, workflows, and systems
  • Partner closely with the People org, engineering, data, security, legal, and others to make sound product and architecture tradeoffs
  • Define measures to understand adoption, engagement, and impact for products and develop insights into the metrics to guide improvements to the product
  • Develop agentic People products and define where systems may recommend, act, escalate, or defer to accountable human judgment
  • Use AI-enabled tools throughout product development and help establish effective practices for AI-assisted discovery, prototyping, specification, testing, and iteration
  • Lead adoption and establish sustainable ownership and support for products that change established ways of working

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of product management or equivalent experience leading the development of software products for internal or external users
  • Experience independently navigating ambiguity, identifying the underlying user problem, and converting broad strategies into focused product roadmaps
  • Experience shipping products that connect workflows, data, and multiple systems or teams
  • Practical understanding of AI and machine-learning product development beyond using LLM-based tools, including model capabilities, data requirements, evaluation methods, failure modes, privacy considerations, and the tradeoffs between probabilistic, deterministic, and human-led approaches
  • Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve the quality and speed of product discovery, prototyping, delivery, or evaluation
  • Demonstrated ability to lead across functions and build alignment among stakeholders with different expertise, incentives, and responsibilities
  • Experience designing products where user trust, privacy, permissions, or other sensitive requirements are central to the product experience

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with employee products, human-resources technology, People operations, enterprise workflow, or manager-facing tools
  • Experience building governed data products, self-service experiences, or role-aware applications
  • Experience shipping agentic or AI/ML-powered products for People or another trust-sensitive domain, with appropriate evaluation, privacy safeguards, escalation, and human accountability
  • Experience leading adoption and organizational change for products that replace established manual processes

Position Title: Compliance & Regulatory Operations Manager (Mexico)
Location: Mexico – Hybrid Employment Type: Full-time Reporting to: Country Manager, Mexico (solid line) / Global Chief Compliance Officer (dotted line)

Company Overview

Telcoin is a global fintech company focused on developing innovative financial products and infrastructure at the intersection of telecommunications, payments, and digital assets (Stablecoins).
Established in 2017, Telcoin operates through entities across multiple international markets and continues to expand its regulated financial services footprint.
As we develop our business in Mexico, we are seeking an experienced Compliance & Regulatory Operations Manager who can lead our local compliance function while also taking a hands-on role in regulatory applications, licensing initiatives, and broader business operations.

Role Overview

The Compliance & Regulatory Operations Manager will be a key member of Telcoin Mexico's leadership team.
The role will have a solid-line reporting relationship to the Country Manager in Mexico, while maintaining a dotted-line relationship to Telcoin's Global Chief Compliance Officer and working closely with Telcoin's global Compliance, Legal, Product, Operations, Finance, and Risk teams.  This is a hands-on leadership role, not a purely advisory one. You will move between regulatory interpretation and practical execution: leading Telcoin's financial institution application from preparation through regulatory review, owning the local AML/CFT program end to end, and acting as a trusted advisor to the Country Manager on how regulatory requirements shape the business, including virtual-assest-related obligations.  The person joining us should therefore be comfortable working in an environment where regulatory, operational, and commercial workstreams frequently overlap.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Strategy & Licensing

  • Work closely with the Country Manager, Global Chief Compliance Officer, Legal team, senior management, and external regulatory advisers to execute Telcoin's regulatory strategy in Mexico.
  • Take a hands-on role in preparing regulatory applications, supporting documentation, policies, procedures, business plans, operating models, risk assessments, and responses to regulatory inquiries.
  • Support Telcoin's planned application for authorization as an financial institution and help manage the application and authorization process from preparation through regulatory review.
  • Support other registrations and regulatory initiatives relevant to Telcoin's business model, including:
    • SAT registration and ongoing obligations relating to Actividades Vulnerables involving virtual assets;
    • applicable CNBV registrations or authorizations;
    • additional financial-services permissions that may become necessary as the Mexican business develops.
  • Coordinate regulatory projects across Telcoin's local and global teams and external advisers.
  • Track regulatory submissions, outstanding requirements, dependencies, deadlines, and regulator requests.
  • Serve as a key point of contact with Mexican regulators and governmental authorities where appropriate.

AML / CFT & Compliance Management

  • Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve Telcoin Mexico's AML/CFT and financial-crime compliance framework.
  • Maintain local policies and procedures in accordance with Mexican law while ensuring appropriate alignment with Telcoin Group's global compliance standards.
  • Conduct and maintain AML/CFT and other regulatory risk assessments applicable to the Mexican business.
  • Oversee customer due diligence, KYC, enhanced due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and related financial-crime controls.
  • Ensure required regulatory notices, reports, and other filings are submitted accurately and within applicable deadlines.
  • Review potentially suspicious customer or transactional activity and coordinate escalation and reporting processes where required.
  • Maintain appropriate compliance records, registers, evidence, and documentation.
  • Monitor regulatory developments in Mexico and assess their impact on Telcoin's products and operations.
  • Work with the Global Compliance team to continuously strengthen Telcoin's compliance framework and controls.
  • Support regulatory inspections, audits, information requests, and remediation programs.

Business & Regulatory Operations

This role will also act as a hands-on business partner to the Country Manager.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Supporting the Country Manager with regulatory, operational, and administrative requirements involved in establishing and scaling Telcoin's Mexican business.
  • Helping translate regulatory requirements into practical product and operational processes.
  • Working with Product and Engineering teams to ensure regulatory requirements are appropriately incorporated into product development.
  • Coordinating with banks, payment partners, vendors, consultants, lawyers, auditors, and other third parties required to establish Telcoin's operations.
  • Assisting with business applications, due diligence requests, questionnaires, banking relationships, vendor onboarding, and regulatory documentation.
  • Supporting the development of operating procedures and internal controls as the local organization grows.
  • Taking ownership of projects outside of traditional compliance responsibilities where necessary to help establish and grow the Mexican business.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable rolling up their sleeves and getting things done, rather than operating solely as a policy or advisory function.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Significant professional experience in compliance, regulatory affairs, financial crime, legal/regulatory operations, or a closely related role within Mexico.
  • Strong practical knowledge of the Mexican financial-services regulatory environment.
  • Experience working with or interacting with Mexican regulators such as CNBV, SAT, SHCP/UIF, or Banco de México.
  • Practical experience with AML/CFT, KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring, regulatory reporting, and compliance controls.
  • Experience preparing regulatory documentation and coordinating complex regulatory or licensing projects.
  • Ability to independently manage projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Commercial mindset and ability to understand how regulatory requirements affect products and business models.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where processes and regulatory structures are still being built.
  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English.
  • Resident in Mexico.

Highly Desirable

  • Previous experience working for an Financial Institution fintech, payments company, digital asset company, bank, money transmitter, or other regulated financial institution in Mexico.
  • Direct experience supporting an Financial Institution authorization or another CNBV financial institution licensing process.
  • Experience establishing a compliance program or regulated operation from an early stage.
  • Knowledge of Mexican regulation relating to virtual assets and Actividades Vulnerables.
  • Experience working with cryptocurrency, blockchain, stablecoins, digital wallets, cross-border payments, or other digital financial products.
  • CNBV certification in PLD/FT/FPADM, or eligibility and willingness to obtain the applicable certification.
  • Experience working within an international organization and coordinating with global Compliance, Legal, Product, and Operations teams.

The Person We're Looking For

The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a compliance professional, regulatory project manager, and business operator.
You should be comfortable interpreting regulation and discussing technical compliance requirements with lawyers and regulators, but equally comfortable opening a spreadsheet, preparing an application, coordinating documentation, working with a banking partner, reviewing a product workflow, or helping the Country Manager solve an operational problem.
Telcoin Mexico is entering an important stage of its development, including preparations for additional financial-services authorization. This role provides an opportunity to help build the regulatory and operational foundation of the business rather than simply maintain an established compliance program.

Application Process

Interested candidates should submit a resume outlining their relevant experience, particularly any experience involving Mexican financial-services regulation, AML/CFT, fintech, payments, digital assets, or regulatory licensing.
Please highlight any relevant professional certifications, including CNBV AML/CFT certification, and any direct experience with a financial institution authorization processes in Mexico.
Telcoin is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

About ComplyAdvantage

ComplyAdvantage is the financial industry’s leading source of AI-driven financial crime risk data and detection technology. Our mission is to neutralize the risk of money laundering, terrorist financing, corruption, and other financial crimes.

More than 1,000 companies globally rely on us to navigate risk through the world’s only real-time database of people and companies. Backed by Goldman Sachs, Ontario Teachers’, Index Ventures, and Balderton Capital, we have raised over $100M to date. After growing our team by 40% last year, we are scaling from 500 to 600+ people - and our SDR team is the engine behind that growth.

The role

This is a people-leadership role first. As Head of Business Development for EMEA, you own the outbound business development (BDR) function across the region — hiring, developing, and leading a team of BDRs whose job is to generate qualified pipeline for our new-business sales organization.

You will set the outbound strategy, build the ramp and coaching systems that make reps successful, and create the career pathways that turn strong BDRs into future account executives. Your success is measured by the performance, retention, and progression of the team you build — and by the quality of pipeline they generate for the business.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and coach the team. Run daily coaching, call reviews, and 1:1s that raise the performance of every BDR — developing outbound craft, resilience, and commercial judgment across the group.
  • Own the hiring bar. Run a structured, competency-based interview process, and keep a bench of talent ahead of demand so the team can scale without dropping quality.
  • Design onboarding and ramp. Build and run a structured 90-day onboarding program with clear milestone gates, so new hires reach full productivity faster.
  • Build career pathways. Maintain a competency framework with assessable junior and senior behaviors, and create clear BDR-to-AE progression that helps you attract and retain ambitious reps.
  • Set the outbound strategy. Define account prioritization, ideal-customer-profile targeting, messaging, and multi-channel sequencing across EMEA, in partnership with Sales and Marketing.
  • Own pipeline generation. Carry the team’s qualified-pipeline target, forecast opportunities into the new-business funnel, and use data to diagnose and fix what is not working.
  • Partner across the business. Work with Revenue Operations on tooling, routing, reporting, and compensation design, and align closely with Marketing on account-based programs.
  • Report on performance. Give sales leadership a clear, evidence-based view of team health, ramp, and pipeline contribution.

 

Proficient with: 

 

  • Cognism
  • Salesforce
  • Sales Nav
  • Clay
  • Building multi-outreach 
  • Insights into performing channels

What you’ll bring

People-management experience is essential. We are looking for someone with a strong track record of managing an outbound BDR or SDR team — you have hired, coached, and retained reps and led a team to target, not only carried a number yourself.

  • Team leadership. Proven experience leading and developing outbound BDRs/SDRs, with a genuine interest in growing people and a record of moving reps into more senior roles.
  • Building the function. Experience designing or scaling onboarding, ramp, coaching, and performance frameworks — not just running the ones you inherited.
  • Outbound craft. Strong command of prospecting, multi-channel sequencing, and qualification (MEDDIC or a similar framework), with the ability to teach it.
  • Data fluency. Comfortable in Salesforce and reporting tools, using metrics to manage a team, forecast pipeline, and make decisions.
  • Commercial background. Experience selling or generating pipeline in B2B SaaS; exposure to RegTech, FinTech, financial services, or compliance is an advantage.
  • The right blend. The emotional intelligence to develop people, and the operational rigor to run a team at scale across multiple markets.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or managing teams across multiple EMEA markets.
  • Familiarity with anti-money laundering (AML), sanctions, or wider financial crime compliance.
  • Experience partnering with Marketing on account-based experience (ABX) or account-based marketing (ABM) programs.

How we work

Our values shape how this team operates, and we hire for them:

  • Make a safer world. The work matters — we help stop the movement of funds that fuel serious crime.
  • Raise the bar. We hold a high standard for ourselves and each other, and we keep getting better.
  • See it, own it, drive it forward. We take ownership and follow through.
  • Win as one team. We succeed together, across functions and regions.

About us

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime. 

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.

ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, Goldman Sachs, and Andreessen Horowitz. Learn more about compliance re-engineered for the age of AI at complyadvantage.com.

We’re Trezor, the company that invented the world’s first hardware wallet and a leading name in crypto security. Founded in 2013 and still 100% self-owned, we build open-source products that help more than two million people across 200+ countries secure their digital assets.

As a Crypto Backend Engineer, you’ll work on the infrastructure connecting Trezor Suite to blockchain networks and crypto data services — powering everything from account discovery and transaction history to fee estimation, token metadata, and transaction broadcasting.

You’ll build services that stay reliable even when blockchain nodes, RPC providers, or third-party APIs don’t. You’ll own your work end to end, influence architecture and observability, and help shape the long-term direction of Trezor’s blockchain infrastructure.

You don’t need to know every blockchain we support on day one. What matters is your ability to understand unfamiliar systems, investigate how they behave under failure, and turn that knowledge into reliable production software.

If this sounds like the kind of infrastructure you’d like to own, keep reading.

💪 What You’ll Be Working On

  • Blockchain connectivity - building and improving reliable communication with nodes, RPC providers, explorers, and indexers across UTXO and account-based networks

  • Blockbook development & maintenance - maintaining and actively developing Blockbook, an open-source blockchain indexer created by Trezor and used by major RPC providers such as QuickNode and NOWNodes

  • Backend services - developing services for fiat rates, token and coin metadata, fees, and other crypto data used throughout Trezor Suite

  • Third-party integrations - integrating and evaluating providers such as QuickNode while designing sensible caching, fallback, and routing strategies

  • Reliability at scale - improving monitoring, logging, alerting, request optimization, and incident detection so users barely notice provider failures

  • Architecture and ownership - contributing to technical decisions, architecture reviews, and infrastructure planning

  • Security and collaboration - working closely with DevOps, Security, and product engineering teams to operate dependable and secure services

💪 About You

  • You have production experience building backend services in TypeScript/Node.js or Go

  • Experience designing, operating, and debugging APIs or distributed services

  • Solid knowledge of SQL databases, preferably PostgreSQL, and practical data modelling

  • Ability to investigate failures across application, network, database, and third-party service boundaries

  • Understanding of production observability, including metrics, logs, tracing, and alerting

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make pragmatic technical decisions

  • Good written and spoken English

Nice to have:

  • Experience with blockchain nodes, RPC APIs, indexers, explorers, or other crypto infrastructure

  • Understanding of UTXO and account-based blockchain models

  • Experience integrating third-party crypto-data services

  • Familiarity with Docker, containerized deployments, caching, queues, or cloud infrastructure

  • Knowledge of multiple blockchain ecosystems and their network protocols

  • Open-source contributions

✍️ Our Stack

  • TypeScript, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Docker

  • Blockchain nodes, RPC APIs, explorers, indexers, and third-party data providers

  • Monitoring, logging, and alerting tooling for production services

  • Git and an open-source development workflow

  • Check out our GitHub

🤝 What We Offer

  • A unique opportunity to be part of a pioneering, security-first company in the crypto industry

  • A role where you can build, implement, and see the real impact of your work

  • The chance to work in an open-source company where transparency, trust, and security are part of how we think

  • A high level of ownership and freedom — you’ll have real influence over the architecture and reliability of our blockchain infrastructure

  • Option to get paid in bitcoin

  • Flexible working hours and a supportive team

  • Budget for professional development, including training programs, courses, and workshops of your choice

  • Friendly, open culture with regular company events and fun get-togethers

  • Renovated offices with a gym, football table, billiards, PlayStation, 3D printer and free on-site parking

  • Additional benefits such as a MultiSport card, company mobile phone tariff, massages, yoga, fitness classes, and more

👋 Sounds good? We’d love to hear from you: just submit your CV and tell us about something you've shipped that you're proud of. We’ll get back to you as soon as we review your application, most likely within a week.

Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

The Growth Partnerships Lead drives growth and customer acquisition by building and optimizing Phantom's global affiliate program from zero to one. This role is responsible for recruiting, onboarding, and managing a network of affiliates, influencers, KOLs, and content partners who can effectively promote Phantom products to their audiences. The ideal candidate is a strategic, data-driven marketer with prior experience with crypto audiences and partners who can build and develop these key business relationships.

Responsibilities

  • Program management: Develop and implement strategies to build the inaugural affiliate program and drive new funded wallets and traders on Phantom.

  • Partner recruitment: Identify and recruit high-quality affiliate partners, including content creators, influencers, KOLs, and financial publishers.

  • Relationship management: Build and maintain strong relationships with top-tier affiliates, offering support, guidance, and incentives to maximize their performance.

  • Performance analysis: Monitor, analyze, and report on program performance using key metrics such as clicks, conversions, ROI, and revenue. Use these insights to optimize campaigns and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Content collaboration: Work with affiliates to create high-impact promotional content, such as reviews, guides, and tutorials, that effectively communicates Phantoms value proposition.

  • Tool management: Leverage affiliate tracking software (Impact, which Phantom uses for its program) to manage assets, track performance, and process payments. Own roadmap for technology improvements and event pipeline.

Requirements:

  • 5 - 7 years of experience in affiliate marketing for consumer fintech businesses, particularly app-based businesses

  • Proven track record of developing and launching affiliate marketing programs at global scale

  • Deep understanding of affiliate partnership ecosystem in crypto (publishers, KOLs, influencers)

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product and Data and managing external agencies

  • Excellent communication and storytelling abilities to convey product benefits through branded content

  • Passion for crypto, web3, and the future of decentralized finance (or a willingness to learn and immerse yourself in the space)


Why Work with Us

Opportunity

We are a team of experienced builders who started from a simple belief: crypto should be easy, beautiful, and available to everyone. That conviction has fueled our growth to 20M+ users, a #1 ranking in the Google Play Store finance category, and a product that consistently ranks among the top consumer technology platforms in the world.

There has never been a better time to work in crypto and at Phantom, you’ll help shape how tens of millions of people experience it every day. The Brand Creative team sits at the center of that mission, building the visual language that makes Phantom feel like the most trusted, most polished product in the space.

  • First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem.

  • Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do.

  • We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Eligibility to participate in performance bonus program

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision) 100% covered

  • Stipend for your ideal remote / WFH set-up: laptop, headphones, and any other work gear you may need

  • Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Wellness benefit

  • Daily lunch benefit

 

The target base salary for this role will range between $140,000 to $180,000 with the addition of equity and benefits. This is determined by a few factors including your skillset, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews and market factors at the point in time of offer.

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
descriptions.job-1tk2vlg:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

We're looking for a Paid Social Manager to own and scale Polymarket's paid acquisition across social channels. You'll sit within the Growth team, reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, and work alongside creative, analytics, and product to build a performance engine that matches the pace of our growth. The mandate is straightforward: manage significant paid media budgets across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, X, and beyond, drive efficient user acquisition, and build the systems that make us better at this over time.

This isn't a role where you hand off execution to an agency or wait for someone else to define the strategy. Paid social is one of our highest-leverage growth channels and we're at a stage where doing it well — or poorly — has a direct and visible impact on the business. We need someone who has managed budgets at scale, reads performance signals quickly, and can build a creative feedback loop that keeps our ads sharp as we grow.

What You'll Do

  • Manage and optimize live campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, X, Snapchat, and emerging channels, with full ownership of pacing, budget allocation, and performance against CAC and LTV targets

  • Review creative performance weekly, identify what is working and why, and brief new concepts directly to the creative team based on data signals

  • Run incrementality and measurement tests to validate spend efficiency across channels and inform how budget is allocated across the portfolio

  • Monitor and audit full conversion funnels — from ad click through landing page to account creation — and flag or fix drop-off points that are costing us efficiency

  • Build and maintain performance reporting that gives leadership a clear, current view of channel mix, spend pacing, and contribution to company P&L

  • Identify and launch net-new paid channels, document what you learn, and build playbooks the team can run without you having to be in every decision

  • Partner with creative, product, and analytics teams to connect ad-level performance data back to messaging strategy, offer design, and landing page structure

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in performance marketing or paid acquisition, with hands-on campaign management experience — not just oversight

  • Proven experience managing $50M to $100M+ in annual paid media spend, with direct accountability for efficiency metrics

  • Deep hands-on experience across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, and X, including campaign setup, audience strategy, and bid management

  • Cross-environment buying experience across both web and mobile app, with an understanding of how attribution and optimization differ between the two

  • Structured approach to creative testing and iteration, including how you brief concepts, set up tests, and translate results into the next round of creative

  • Strong analytical foundation, including working knowledge of attribution models beyond last-click and experience running or interpreting incrementality tests

  • Comfortable owning budget decisions and defending them with data in a fast-moving environment

  • (Plus) Experience in fintech, trading, or consumer financial products

  • (Plus) Familiarity with incrementality testing frameworks such as geo-based holdouts or intent-to-treat analysis

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $180,000 to $220,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.
descriptions.job-1qlufck:
Solutions Architect | LATAM

Our Solutions Architecture team connects business priorities with practical technical solutions, helping customers understand how Chainalysis can support their most important objectives.

In this role, you will provide technical leadership throughout the customer journey. You will turn complex requirements into clear recommendations, help customers envision how our products fit into their operating environment, and guide them toward measurable business outcomes.

As a Solutions Architect, you'll develop a deep understanding of Chainalysis solutions and the problems our customers are trying to solve. You'll explain complex concepts in a clear, compelling way to technical practitioners, business leaders, and executive stakeholders. You'll also build practical, customer-specific solutions that support deployment, integration, adoption, and long-term value.

In this role, you'll:

  • Serve as a core member of the account team, partnering closely with Sales, Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.

  • Take ownership of customer outcomes across the full lifecycle, from initial discovery and solution design through investigation support, compliance program delivery, deployment, enablement, adoption, and expansion.

  • Lead discovery conversations that uncover customer objectives, operational pain points, use cases, technical constraints, and success criteria.

  • Translate business and operational needs into clear technical requirements, solution designs, and implementation paths.

  • Articulate Chainalysis capabilities in a way that is relevant to each customer's compliance, risk, fraud, investigations, or security environment.

  • Create tailored demonstrations, proof-of-value experiences, and technical narratives that show how Chainalysis can address customer priorities.

  • Conduct blockchain investigations, deliver compliance and regulatory guidance, and build technical solutions such as notebooks, dashboards, automation workflows, data integrations, reference architectures, and agentic workflows.

  • Develop AI-assisted workflows that accelerate and automate investigations, analysis, and customer processes, adapted to each customer's operating model, data, controls, and risk framework.

  • Design automation that fits into existing compliance, risk, fraud, investigations, or security operations rather than requiring customers to redesign how they work.

  • Help customers access and operationalize Chainalysis data through APIs, integrations, and fit-for-purpose technical patterns.

  • Provide guidance on solution architecture, API implementation, workflow design, data movement, and integration considerations.

  • Drive platform adoption by connecting customer workflows to Chainalysis capabilities and identifying new use cases.

  • Identify creative, responsible approaches to difficult customer problems, while balancing speed, scalability, security, maintainability, and measurable impact.

  • Build trust through sound technical judgment, clear communication, reliable execution, and a strong understanding of the customer's business.

  • Assemble the technical evidence base, including outcome data, consumption metrics, adoption analysis, and expansion signals, that supports quarterly impact reporting and renewal conversations.

  • Build customer capability and self-sufficiency rather than creating ongoing dependence on the Solutions Architecture team.

  • Own the feedback loop between customers and Product/Engineering, translating field insights and feature requirements into product improvements and bringing those improvements back to customers.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers, meeting them at their current level of crypto-maturity and partnering with them to advance their understanding, processes, and outcomes.

  • Represent Chainalysis at customer meetings, industry events, and conferences.

  • Contribute to the wider Solutions Architecture team through reusable assets, knowledge sharing, internal initiatives, and better ways of working.

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • Several years of experience in one or more relevant areas, such as financial services, compliance, investigations, fraud, cybersecurity, digital assets, transaction monitoring, sales engineering, solutions architecture, or enterprise product management.

  • Experience making complex technical or operational concepts understandable to different audiences.

  • Strong storytelling, presentation, and written communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

  • A creative, structured, and investigative approach to solving challenging customer problems.

  • Comfort working with technical tools and learning new technologies quickly. Experience with Python or another programming language, SQL, data analysis, notebooks, workflow automation, APIs, integrations, or AI tools is valuable.

  • The curiosity and initiative to develop technical depth over time; you do not need to arrive with a complete technical stack, but you should enjoy investigating how things work and building the skills to solve new problems.

  • The ability to operate effectively when requirements are ambiguous, information is incomplete, or the best path forward has not yet been defined.

  • A collaborative, generous approach to working with others, including a willingness to share knowledge, seek input, and improve team practices.

  • A demonstrated focus on measurable customer outcomes, not simply technical activity or product usage.

  • An interest in blockchain and a desire to keep building your understanding of the technology, the market, and the customers we serve.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

zerohash is looking for a Customer Experience Specialist to join our high-performing CX team. In this role, you will deliver exceptional, human-centered support across B2C and B2B channels, helping customers navigate complex inquiries around KYC, digital asset transactions, and account management.

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global. zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more. zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

Follow us

Twitter

LinkedIn

Youtube

Blog

their uses, calculations and limitations * Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, plus working fluency with AI tools such as Gemini or Claude * Exceptional verbal and written communication, with strong collaboration and interpersonal skillsYou'll Excel in This Role If You * Think in first principles and act like an owner of the P&L, not a reporter of it * Are as comfortable in the detail of a dataset as you are summarising it in one slide for leadership * Communicate with precision and empathy, and build working relationships with business stakeholders quickly * Thrive in ambiguity and build clarity from incomplete data * Have a bias for automation - About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About The Role 

DriveWealth LLC is seeking a highly motivated and seasoned VP, FCM, Tokenization & Stablecoin Compliance Officer in either our New York or Chicago office to lead compliance for the firm’s expansion into event-based prediction markets and stablecoin/tokenization initiatives. Reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer, you will build and lead the compliance program supporting DriveWealth’s FCM registration and NFA membership, alongside the firm’s growing digital asset and stablecoin footprint.

In this leadership role, you will provide expert guidance on complex regulatory matters spanning CFTC and NFA rules governing futures commission merchants, prediction and event contract markets (including our relationship with Kalshi), and the regulatory frameworks applicable to stablecoin issuance, custody, and tokenization. This is a build role: as firms across the industry, including Robinhood and other fintech and brokerage platforms, expand into similar products, we are seeking a leader who has directly navigated this regulatory landscape and can stand up a compliant, scalable program while shaping firm-wide controls within an innovative and entrepreneurial culture.

What You’ll Do

Program Build-Out & Team Leadership

  • Program Development: Build and lead the compliance function supporting DriveWealth’s FCM registration, NFA membership, and stablecoin/tokenization initiatives, hiring and developing staff as the business scales.
  • Workflow Oversight: Manage and re-prioritize team workloads across FCM, prediction market, and stablecoin/tokenization workstreams to ensure multiple projects and regulatory deadlines are met simultaneously.
  • Quality Assurance: Review and approve detailed reports and surveillance investigations prepared by staff covering prediction market trading activity and stablecoin/tokenized asset transactions to ensure accurate summarization of issues and logical solutions.

Regulatory Advisory & Operations

  • Business Advisory: Advise business units on CFTC, NFA, and applicable state and federal digital asset regulatory obligations tied to prediction markets and stablecoins, as well as new rule proposals and firm policies.
  • Compliance Frameworks: Design, implement, and maintain effective compliance frameworks aligned with CFTC, NFA, state money transmitter and stablecoin regulatory regimes (e.g., the GENIUS Act), and other regulatory obligations.
  • Policy Governance: Oversee the development and maintenance of Written Supervisory Procedures (WSPs) for FCM operations, and internal policies governing stablecoin reserves, redemption mechanics, and tokenized asset custody.
  • Strategic Partnership: Proactively partner with Kalshi and other prediction market venues, stablecoin/tokenization technology partners, the firm’s Financial Crimes team, business management, risk, and technology to ensure sound business operations and facilitate the firm's success.

Monitoring & Surveillance

  • Level 2 Oversight: Perform Level 2 compliance reviews of prediction market and stablecoin/tokenization activity directly in the early stages of this role, transitioning to a supervisory capacity as the team is built out, ensuring firm-wide adherence to internal standards throughout.
  • Surveillance Logic: Enhance surveillance and monitoring frameworks covering event contract trading patterns and stablecoin transaction activity by refining detection logic and identifying patterns in large trade and transaction datasets, partnering with the firm’s Financial Crimes team on BSA/AML and Travel Rule monitoring.
  • Regulatory Reporting: Develop and analyze data for Compliance management reports, including FCM financial/segregation reporting and stablecoin reserve attestations, and provide periodic status updates on key issues.

Examinations & Inquiries

  • Exam Leadership: Lead the firm’s response to regulatory exams and inquiries from the CFTC, NFA, state money transmitter regulators, and other applicable authorities related to FCM and stablecoin/tokenization activities.
  • Audit Support: Coordinate the collection of documentation and ensure timely follow-up for all regulatory inquiries.

You Bring

  • Bachelor’s Degree; J.D. or other advanced degree a plus.
  • 12+ years of Compliance, Legal, Regulatory, or Financial Services experience, including at least 5+ years focused directly on futures/derivatives (FCM) compliance and/or stablecoin, tokenization, or digital asset regulatory compliance.
  • Deep understanding of CFTC and NFA rules governing futures commission merchants, prediction and event contract markets, and derivatives clearing, along with direct, hands-on experience with stablecoin issuance, tokenization, digital asset custody, and related regulatory frameworks (e.g., the GENIUS Act, OCC guidance, and state money transmitter licensing). Comfortable partnering closely with the firm’s Financial Crimes team on BSA/AML and Travel Rule matters as they apply to these products.
  • Required: Series 3 (National Commodity Futures Examination), with Series 30 (NFA Branch Manager) strongly preferred; FINRA Series 7 and 24 and NFA Swaps Proficiency Requirements (Swaps Certificate) are a plus. An AML certification (e.g., CAMS) is a plus for coordinating with the firm’s Financial Crimes team, though this role does not own BSA/AML program responsibilities.
  • Proven build experience: Track record standing up or scaling a compliance program for a new product line, ideally at a firm expanding into prediction markets and/or digital assets, such as Robinhood, Kalshi, or a comparable platform.
  • Strong ability to work with large trade and transaction datasets and translate complex, cross-regulatory requirements into practical control updates.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to interface with all levels of management and build effective relationships.

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: Office/Hybrid: New York City, Chicago. Remote: Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco Bay Area, or Seattle. 

  • If based in New York or Chicago: This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If based in Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco, or Seattle: This is a fully remote role, though you may need to visit our onsite offices from time to time.
  • If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $225,000 – $250,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

This position sits within Ramp’s Channel team and reports to Partner Consulting. In this role, you’ll build and scale Ramp’s long-term System Integrator (SI)-led implementation program. You’ll enable a broad ecosystem of implementation partners to support a meaningful volume of Ramp-referred customers, deliver high-quality implementations, and extend the capacity of Ramp’s Customer Success organization.

 

Ramp’s current SI pilot is the starting point - not the end state. You’ll translate the pilot’s learnings into the operating model, technical readiness, commercial foundations, and quality controls required to scale responsibly from an initial cohort to a broad network of partners across products, ERP ecosystems, and geographies.

 

You’ll be Ramp’s technical and programmatic owner for SI delivery: enabling partners to implement Ramp successfully, defining clear scope and certification standards, measuring implementation quality and customer outcomes, and turning field learnings into improvements across product, enablement, and partner strategy.

 

This is a senior IC role, not a people-management role. You’ll need equal credibility in technical implementation conversations and commercial partner-program design, working closely with Channel Partner Managers, Solutions, Customer Success, Product, Product Operations, Accounting Integrations, Legal, Security, and Finance.

What You'll Do

  • Build and scale the SI operating model, including partner segmentation, certification tiers, service packages, implementation methodology, scope boundaries, escalation paths, quality standards, and performance management.

  • Own partner readiness and technical enablement across Ramp configuration, ERP integrations, data migration, testing, cutover, and customer change management - defining what partners can deliver independently, when Ramp co-delivery is required, and what remains out of scope.

  • Serve as the first-line technical strategist for SI partners: resolve standard implementation and integration questions, orchestrate specialist support for true exceptions, and convert recurring issues into scalable playbooks, training, or product feedback.

  • Establish the delivery-quality and performance system for the program, including implementation reviews, certification gates, QBRs, customer feedback loops, remediation plans, and reporting on time-to-live, activation, CSAT, rework, capacity, cost-to-serve, and partner-sourced or partner-influenced pipeline.

  • Design the commercial and capacity model in partnership with Channel and Finance, including fixed fees, milestone-based payouts, accelerators, partner capacity commitments, joint business planning, and the program economics required to scale sustainably.

  • Lead responsible program expansion across new products, ERP ecosystems, and geographies; set readiness gates for complex offerings such as Procurement, and influence Product, Product Operations, Product Marketing, and Accounting Integrations using structured field feedback.

What You Need

  • Significant senior-level experience scaling an implementation, services, or partner-delivery motion from pilot through repeatable multi-partner execution.

  • Experience in a partner-ecosystem-dependent technology business, such as ERP, accounting, finance operations, procurement, or enterprise SaaS or at a systems integrator/consulting firm that implements those platforms.

  • Demonstrated ownership of implementation quality and customer outcomes, including scope control, partner certification, delivery QA, and escalation governance.

  • Technical fluency to lead credible conversations about integrations, configuration, data migration, ERP workflows, and implementation design; engineering depth is not required, but sound judgment on when to engage specialists is.

  • Commercial judgment to design partner packages, incentives, capacity commitments, payout structures, and guardrails that protect customer outcomes and program economics.

  • Ability to build 0-to-1 operating mechanisms and trusted senior relationships across a diverse partner ecosystem - from specialized regional SIs to global strategic consultancies - including the confidence to challenge partners and internal stakeholders when delivery readiness is insufficient.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or scaling a white-label, staff-augmentation, or outcome-based services model.

  • Experience with Card, Bill Pay, Procurement, AP automation, ERP integrations, multi-entity environments, or global finance operations.

  • Experience expanding an SI/channel program across North America and international markets.

  • Prior 0-to-1 partner-program or services-program experience.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Establish the SI operating model, including partner readiness, certification, service packages, quality standards, escalation paths, and reporting.

  • Enable existing partners to deliver the supported scope with greater independence, predictable quality, and a commercial model tied to verified milestones and customer outcomes.

  • Publish a data-backed expansion plan across products, ERP ecosystems, and regions, with clear readiness gates for complex offerings such as Procurement.

And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you're ready to see your impact and embrace meaningful challenges, join us, and build real world value.

Every payment, every custody operation, and every line of code at Ripple runs on the infrastructure our platform teams build. We operate a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-native environment spanning multiple regions and regulatory jurisdictions, engineered for the availability and security standards our financial institution customers expect — and for the developer velocity our engineers need. The systems this organization owns are the substrate for everything Ripple ships.

We have a big vision and the ambition to match. We are seeking the same in engineering leaders. You see infrastructure not as plumbing but as leverage: the difference between an engineering organization that ships weekly and one that ships continuously, between a platform that survives a regional outage and one that doesn't notice it happened.

We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader to develop and guide the teams responsible for Ripple's cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platform, and developer experience.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the technical and organizational strategy managing multi-cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platform at Ripple, balancing reliability, security, cost, and developer velocity y
  • Lead multiple teams and managers across compute platform, cloud infrastructure, developer experience, and reliability engineering
  • Define and deliver the multi-year infrastructure roadmap, including cluster architecture, workload orchestration, service networking, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD
  • Set the standard for operational excellence — SLOs, incident response, on-call health, blameless postmortems, and dynamic rollout practices — and hold the organization to it
  • Drive multi-cloud strategy and execution: workload placement, portability, avoiding accidental lock-in, disaster recovery, and multi-region resilience
  • Partner with Security and Compliance to build infrastructure that satisfies SOC 2, ISO 27001, and jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements without slowing engineering down
  • Own cloud spend for your organization, with clear accountability for efficiency and unit economics as the platform scales
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership — architecture reviews, design docs, incident escalations, and the occasional pull request
  • Mentor and grow the professional and technical development of your team, both managers and individual contributors
  • Establish team objectives and quarterly plans in alignment with business and organizational goals
  • Translate infrastructure investments into terms that resonate with engineers, product leaders, and executives alike
  • Scale the organization by attracting, hiring, and developing exceptional leaders and engineers at all levels

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 12+ years of hands-on software and infrastructure engineering experience, including 5+ years leading teams and managing managers
  • Deep, production-grade experience with Kubernetes at scale — multi-cluster and multi-tenant operations, upgrade strategy, workload isolation, autoscaling, and the failure modes you only learn about the hard way
  • Experience operating across more than one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure) and a clear point of view on where multi-cloud pays for itself and where it doesn't
  • Strong background in infrastructure-as-code and declarative operations (Terraform, Helm, GitOps tooling such as Argo CD or Flux)
  • Track record building highly available, secure distributed systems and the observability to run them (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting that people actually trust)
  • Experience with service networking and service mesh technologies, and with securing traffic and identity across cloud boundaries
  • Demonstrated ability to improve developer experience measurably — build and deploy times, environment provisioning, self-service platform capabilities
  • Experience partnering with security and regulatory oversight functions in a regulated environment; comfort with least-privilege, key management, and audit requirements
  • Experience with Agile development, with a focus on robust design, scalability, and security
  • Solid leadership and communication skills, with the judgment to know when to decide, when to delegate, and when to dig in yourself
  • Eagerness to work openly and collaboratively with a diverse team, with a positive attitude and a passion for sharing knowledge
  • BS or equivalent experience in Computer Science or similar

Nice to have: experience in FinTech, payments, or crypto infrastructure; familiarity with blockchain node operations; exposure to hardware security modules or high-assurance key management systems.

$272,000—$340,000 USD

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.

Take Control of Your Finances

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp Economics Lab is the go-to source for understanding how businesses spend on and adopt AI. Built on Ramp’s $200B+ business spend dataset, our flagship Ramp AI Index tracks the AI economy through actual business spend data. Our research is regularly cited by the Financial Times, The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, The Economist, The New York Times, CNBC, Reuters, Axios, JPMorgan analyst reports, and our favorite independent substacks. You will work with Ara Kharazian, lead economist.

We’re hiring an economics-minded data scientist to own and expand this work: own Ramp AI Index, add new metrics tracking token spend and ROI of AI, extend our research internationally, and publish rigorous but accessible analysis for policymakers, researchers, businesses, the press, and the public.

You’ll also build a new customer-facing economics function from the ground up: developing Ramp’s economic outlook, meeting with customers and prospects, presenting to CFOs and finance teams, and translating our data into practical recommendations for business planning, budgeting, and AI strategy.

This role combines economic judgment, applied data science, public writing, data visualization, and executive communication. You should be able to move from an important question to credible analysis, a clear visual or argument, and advice a business leader can act on.

What You Need

  • Minimum of 5 years of industry experience as a Data Scientist or Economist

  • Strong perspectives on the economics of AI, economic policy, new media, and writing

  • Strong knowledge of SQL (preferably Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery) and how to write efficient SQL queries

  • Familiarity with BI tools (preferably Looker, Omni, Sigma, Hex or equivalent) and experience distributing data insights via reports and dashboards

  • Track record of shipping high-quality research, writing, and thought leadership under short, non-academic timelines

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly improving, start-up environment that focuses on solving problems with iterative technical solutions

  • At some point in the recent past, you have been described as “a breath of fresh air.” You will meet with customers and prospects and present data. It’s very important you don’t come off as dry or overly academic

descriptions.job-19blnzo:
ABOUT SPHERE

Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Compliance is one of the last and largest — and the hardest, because trade rules aren't data to be looked up. They're a complex adaptive system with 190+ sovereign jurisdictions, in different languages, changing constantly, reacting to each other.

Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts. We handle the entire lifecycle — calculation, registration, filing, remittance — at millisecond latency with zero downtime.

  • Backed by a16z and YC. $21M Series A, 30%+ month-over-month growth, customers include ElevenLabs, Replit, Deel, Runway, and Lovable.

  • Small team, global surface area. Everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. San Francisco, five days in office.

  • The problem keeps compounding. Expanding into input tax, withholding, e-invoicing, tariffs — each multiplies the complexity. Tens of millions of transactions today, billions ahead.

 

THE ROLE

Sphere is looking for a Founding Account Executive based in Europe to work closely with the Founder to not only help target European mid-market and enterprise businesses, but also build out our broader EMEA-based GTM function.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Full-cycle sales: run outbound, close new logos, and expand existing accounts.

  • Flex across segments: high-velocity SMB cycles and complex mid-market sales.

  • Build GTM playbooks, assets, and revops stack with the Founder.

  • Help shape and scale our global sales team.

 

REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven experience selling B2B SaaS into SMB and mid-market segments.

  • Early-stage startup experience (building processes from scratch).

 

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience selling to the CFO / Finance roles in Europe

 

WHO YOU ARE

You'll thrive here if:

  • You're a Dog. You've been underestimated, gone through struggle, and never stopped running. You have a chip on your shoulder and enormous drive. You look at Stripe, Deel, and Flexport all punting on compliance and think: good, that means the opportunity is ours. Hunger beats pedigree.

  • Early stage is in your bones. You've built things where there's no playbook and nobody handing you the answer. You define the problem instead of waiting for instructions.

  • You own it end to end. Give you a goal and you figure out your own path. Small team, global surface area — everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. No one tells you how.

  • You believe speed and accuracy are both possible. We're building a complex product that requires robustness and 100% uptime, and we have to build at our customers' pace. Move fast. Don't break things. Both.

  • Being in the room is a feature, not a cost. Five days in SF isn't a policy, it's how the work gets done. The speed and density of collaboration we need doesn't survive over video.

 

This won't be a fit if:

  • You need structure handed to you or ambiguity feels draining rather than motivating

  • You want to manage people more than own hard problems (we're a flat, experienced team — everyone builds)

  • You're used to "good enough" shipping (small errors have outsized impact here)

  • Being in the room five days a week feels like a cost instead of a benefit

President, CoinDesk Media & Events

This is a high-visibility opportunity to lead the premier global forum for the future of money and digital markets, offering an ambitious business builder the platform to shape industry discourse and drive massive commercial impact on a global scale.

This position is based in NYC and will be required to work 4 days per week onsite at our office located in Chelsea.

What You Have:

  • Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in large-scale B2B conference production, commercial media, or experiential events, with a proven track record of running flagship events scaling over 10,000+ attendees.

  • Financial Acumen: Proven experience managing multi-million dollar P&Ls, with a deep understanding of event economics, digital/physical hybrid infrastructure, and corporate sponsorship sales.

  • Industry Context: Experience within tech, media, or financial services events is required; a strong familiarity with the cryptocurrency, blockchain, or fintech landscape is highly preferred.

  • Behavioral Competencies: A charismatic, high-energy leader with exceptional executive presence, sharp negotiation skills, and the ability to remain calm and decisive under high-pressure, fast-moving environments.
